_meta.note: Values marked verified:false could not be sourced from data/reference (tables or patch notes) and are community values. See UNKNOWNS.md. The first fixture read from the game settles them. Patch note citations name the manifest sequence number and date; the newest note wins.

blockCost.source: fixtures 001 and 002 (Yeets-Swiftly): (1750 - 40 Tireless Guardian) x 0.91 (medium -12%, light +3%) = 1556 on the mace bar and x 0.64 more (Ice Staff) = 996 on the staff bar, both exact. The 2018 note (053, 2018-02-26) set 1730; no later note names the base, the sheet says 1750.
blockCost.note: Flat reductions are subtracted from the base first, then percentage reductions (STRATEGIES.costOrder flatThenPercent); armor passives add up, a weapon passive multiplies separately (STRATEGIES.costWeaponPercent).

rollDodgeCost.source: fixture 003 (Yeets-Swiftly naked, Elden Root, no food, 49 Magicka 15 Health points): 3800 on the sheet with Tumbling 240 taken off first. Geared (fixture 002) reads 3248 where the additive passive model gives 3306; the percent stacking for Roll Dodge is still open.

sprintCostPerSecond.source: fixture 003 (Yeets-Swiftly naked, Elden Root, no food, 49 Magicka 15 Health points): 460 = 500 - Sprinter 40; geared (500 - 40) x 0.93 = 428.

breakFreeCost.source: fixture 003 (Yeets-Swiftly naked, Elden Root, no food, 49 Magicka 15 Health points): 5180 = 5400 - Defiance 220; geared (5400 - 220) x 0.95 = 4921.

bashCost.source: fixture 003 (Yeets-Swiftly naked, Elden Root, no food, 49 Magicka 15 Health points): 675 = 765 - Savage Defense 90; geared (765 - 90) x 0.97 = 655.

critResistance.source: data/patch-notes/html 087 (2020-06-09): All players will now have a baseline of 20% Critical Damage Reduction in the form of Critical Resistance, starting at level 10.
critResistance.note: 20% at 66 Critical Resistance per percent. Fixture 003 (naked) reads 1980 = 1320 + Resilience 660.

blockMoveSpeedPercent.note: Block Move Speed on the sheet. Fixtures 001 to 004 all read 42% (naked and geared, no shield); Battlefield Mobility changes it with a shield.

sneakSpeedPercent.note: Sneak Speed on the sheet. Fixtures 003 and 004 (naked) read 60%; light armor reduces the 40 point penalty by 5% per piece (fixture 002 with one light piece reads 62%).

sneakCost.note: Base Stamina cost of Sneak per tick. Fitted: fixtures 003 and 004 read 59 with Sustaining Shadows slotted (1% per stage, 50 stages, so half). The geared 34 (fixture 002) does not follow from the medium armor reductions yet.

esoPlusBonusPercent.source: fixtures 001 to 004: Experience, Gold, Crafting Inspiration, Tel Var and Alliance Points all read 10% with ESO Plus Member in the active effects.

legacyFlatMaxHealth.source: Not applied unless flags.battleSpiritFlatHealth is true: fixture 007 (Cyrodiil) reads 33289, exactly the engine without it. Earlier reading: fixtures 001 and 002 (Yeets-Swiftly): same gear, 22 Health points in Cyrodiil read 32701 and 15 points outside read 30001; 7 points are 7 x 122 x 1.10, the rest is 1600 x 1.10, so Battle Spirit adds 1600 Max Health before percent bonuses. Older notes said 5000: data/patch-notes/html 017 (2016-03-22): fixed: Battle Spirit Health bonus would not be modified by Health percentage increases. data/patch-notes/html 076 (2019-08-26): Pets will now properly gain the extra 5000 Health from Battle Spirit. No note carries the change to 1600.
legacyFlatMaxHealth.note: Applied whenever Battle Spirit is on unless flags.battleSpiritFlatHealth is false.
